meta.title: Larry Football Coaching — Pasco County, FL
meta.description: Professional football coaching in Zephyrhills, FL. Training sessions for youth and high school athletes.

about.name: Coach Larry
about.bio:
"Welcome to Be Legendary Training—where 'Your Success is My Success' becomes a reality. I’m Larry "Coach T" Thomas, a passionate coach and performance specialist with over 35 years of battle-tested experience in football as both a player and a coach. I have worked and studied under the greatest minds in the profession and recently had the privilege to work and coach at IMG Academy. My mission is simple: to push athletes beyond their limits, unlocking peak performance and mastering the position-specific skills that separate good players from great ones.

At Be Legendary Training, we don’t just build champions on the field or court; we cultivate leaders, warriors, and game-changers. With a laser focus on discipline, strategy, and personalized development, I help athletes shatter expectations, dominate their competition, and rise to their ultimate potential. Whether it’s leading teams to championships or mentoring individuals toward greatness, my passion is driving excellence at every level—because when you win, we win."

hero.headline: Pasco County's Premier Football Coach
hero.subline: Personalized football training that turns potential into performance.

testimonials.quote: Coach Larry has a gift for breaking down the fundamentals. My kid went from nervous on the field to one of the most confident players on the team.

testimonials.quote: Nobody pushes me the right way like Coach Larry does. Every session I leave better than I came.
